name: Hybrid search
short_description: Search approach that runs keyword (full-text) and vector queries together and merges the results into one ranked list, for example with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) in Azure AI Search.

evidence.quote: The hybrid breakthrough. Hybrid search is the best of both worlds.
It supports hybrid search, which means it combines traditional keyword matching with vector similarity.
